title: Retrieved document overrides system instructions (prompt injection)
symptoms: Assistant ignores policy and follows instructions embedded in a PDF/web page
Unexpected tool calls after ingesting user content
Leaked system prompt fragments in answers
cause: Untrusted retrieved or user content is concatenated into the model context without isolation, enabling prompt injection (OWASP LLM01).
solution: Treat retrieved text as data not instructions; use delimiters/roles; constrain tools; require citations; add security evals for injection cases.
workaround: Strip instruction-like phrases from retrieved chunks and disable tools for untrusted corpora.
